statements.label: Lemma 1
statements.restatement: If a reduced collision divisor d=0 carries a probability law p (independent of other spectral coordinates) with D_U = sum p F identically on d=0, and E = d e with e a unit at the puncture, then (D_U - sum p F)/E is holomorphic there for any vanishing order of d(t); on a supported branch (all gaps >= 0) the normalized Leibniz sum is locally bounded below.

statements.label: Theorem 2
statements.restatement: For every U in U(4) a probability law on S4 depending only on U represents all principal minors of U diag(alpha,beta,gamma,gamma)U^* for all complex alpha,beta,gamma; hence a uniform determinant law on each internal collision divisor (paper Lemma B.2).

statements.label: Corollary 3
statements.restatement: For a denominator that is a product of collision brackets, every puncture where exactly one factor vanishes has locally bounded negative part on the supported branch, any multiplicity (internal pairs: Thm 2; cross pairs: shared-zero theorem). Two simultaneous factors are explicitly not covered.
